title: Filming: Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1971
content:
Following a book signing in central London, on 16 July 1971 John Lennon and Yoko Ono filmed material for their feature film Imagine.

This was the first of several days in which film footage was captured, although the final edit also included material from the Imagine album sessions from earlier in the year.

On this day Lennon and Ono, plus their assistants Dan Richter and Diana Robertson, were driven to Blue Pools in Wentworth, where they purchased a small house for the island on their artificial lake at Tittenhurst Park. Their film crew captured the footage for the project, which at this time had the working title Your Show.
